detailed_descriptions.en: A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom. Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival! Recruit and Defend Spawn troops to protect your kingdom. Defeat goblins and more to earn gold. Each wave pushes your defenses harder. Upgrade the Kingdom Earn experience, level up your units, and claim crowns to unlock upgrades that strengthen your army and your tower. Carve Your Own Path Battle across a fantasy land, facing unique challenges, testing your build, and conquering new realms. Become Unstoppable Grow stronger over time with larger armies and more powerful abilities, until even the most overwhelming hordes fall.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom.

Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

Recruit and Defend

Spawn troops to protect your kingdom. Defeat goblins and more to earn gold. Each wave pushes your defenses harder.

Upgrade the Kingdom

Earn experience, level up your units, and claim crowns to unlock upgrades that strengthen your army and your tower.

Carve Your Own Path

Battle across a fantasy land, facing unique challenges, testing your build, and conquering new realms.

Become Unstoppable

Grow stronger over time with larger armies and more powerful abilities, until even the most overwhelming hordes fall.
